title: Reference sync check
summary: Compares the reference with its source of truth (an OpenAPI file, schema, CLI help output or code signatures): an inventory from each side, a diff of items missing from the reference, items the source lacks, and mismatches, with defaults checked in code. Without a source it checks internal consistency only and says so. A type check flags instructions, explanation and opinion.

values.label: In sync with the source of truth
No source of truth linked: internal consistency only

notAssessed: Which side is wrong when they differ: the owner decides whether to fix the doc or the source.
Whether examples run: they are checked against the source by reading, not executed.
notes: Link the source of truth (OpenAPI file, schema, CLI help output, code signatures) as a source; without it the check covers internal consistency only.
Best run when the source changes, as well as on demand.
Where the reference is generated from the source, the check reduces to descriptions and examples.
Offer flagged passages to Restructure to type as the seed of a how-to guide or explanation.

config.focus: API, schema, command and configuration definitions: names, parameters, types, defaults, enums, errors

config.instructions: One row per documented item or parameter (an endpoint, command, option, field, setting or error), exactly as the reference states it.

config.instructions: One row per item or parameter the source of truth defines, in the same shape as the reference inventory. Take values only from the source.

config.question: Match each documented item to the source item with the same name. Does the source define it, and do type, default, required, allowed values and deprecation agree? Source items no documented item links to are missing from the reference.
config.instructions: Compare field by field; name every field that differs, with both values, in the rationale.

statuses.label: Not in the source (stale or undocumented in the source)
No source of truth to compare

checks.label: Source defaults appear beside their names

checklist.label: One entry pattern
checklist.question: Does every entry use the same fields in the same order? Name entries that deviate.

checklist.label: Uniform naming
checklist.question: Are names, casing and formatting uniform across entries?

checklist.label: Mirrors the product
checklist.question: Is the grouping and order the same as the product's own structure?

checklist.label: Examples agree with the entries
checklist.question: Does each example use only names, parameters and values the entries (and the source, if linked) define? Name any that do not.

config.instructions: Classify each passage by its Diátaxis role in a reference page.
